basis: Original product plan explicitly requires an error after two model-validation failures, with no default rise or flat. It sets no diagnostic-scenario availability percentage.
criteria: All diagnostic scenarios have terminal outcomes; latest failure is never replaced by older success.
All accepted outputs pass current gates and independent causal/evidence review.
Wrong model outputs are rejected with no default direction.
Real v2 manual, detail, English, current forecast, SSE replay and export smoke succeeds.
API/UI error state is evidenced; either same-record real-v2 failure or explicitly separated legacy-UI plus isolated-v2 evidence.
Old predictions, frozen close snapshots and validation baseline remain preserved.
Unit/frontend/build and final public JSON/JSONL/CSV/SQLite scan pass.
notice: 未全通过；带已知模型可用性限制发布。13/15有效输出、2/15错误被拒为可用性记录，拒绝不算正确预测。
supersedes_unadopted_proposal: The earlier suggested 14/15 or Eni-only rejection threshold was not in the original product plan and was never adopted as a passed acceptance result. Operational release is separate from unchanged strict all-output success.
